A '''stray''' in [[Matcha Flavoured]] is a cold-biome [[skeleton]] variant. It gets the same health and bow changes as skeletons, drops {{ItemLink|Estus Ash}}, and no longer drops plain arrows.

== Spawning ==
Strays use the vanilla spawn rules and, as undead, can spawn on the open surface until the [[Ender Dragon]] is killed. See [[Surface]].

== Drops ==
{{Data/Loot/minecraft/entities/stray}}
Compared to vanilla, strays don't drop plain arrows, and they add {{ItemLink|Estus Ash}} (0–1) when killed by a player. Bones drop on any kill; the tipped arrow of Slowness and estus ash need a player kill.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/entities/stray.json}}</ref>

== Behavior and difficulty ==
Strays are in the <code>#minecraft:skeletons</code> tag, so they are modified like [[skeleton|skeletons]]: {{Hp|10}} on Easy and Normal and {{Hp|12}} on Hard, with a Punch I (Normal) or Punch II (Hard) bow that they don't drop.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/spawn_mechanic/normal_modifications/modify_skeletons.mcfunction}}</ref> They are undead and hurt by [[warding]].
